scene: You skate up onto the open sky deck overlooking three transit bays.
picture: Side view of a level rooftop dock under bright blue skies. On the far left, a round white cloud cable pod sways by an open gate. Left of centre, the player stands on roller skates in her red jacket and ponytail. In the centre, a wooden solar-sail junk rests. On the far right, a dragon-headed maglev train idles.
